BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growth and Development in Plants ● Meaning of growth and development ● Structure? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growth and Development in Plants ● Meaning of growth and development ● Structure.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growth and Development in Plants ● Meaning of growth and development ● Structure.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growth and Development in Plants ● Meaning of growth and development ● Structure.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growth and Development in Plants ● Meaning of growth and development ● Structure.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Reproduction in Animals 3.2 Growth and Development in Animals 3.3 Excretion and ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Reproduction in Animals 3.2 Growth and Development in Animals 3.3 Excretion and .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Reproduction in Animals 3.2 Growth and Development in Animals 3.3 Excretion and .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Reproduction in Animals 3.2 Growth and Development in Animals 3.3 Excretion and .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Reproduction in Animals 3.2 Growth and Development in Animals 3.3 Excretion and .

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Division ● Meaning of cell division and structure of chromosomes ● Types of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
